The double-reference versus stored float rounding difference reaches .9148163311 Pa/s at a 2.4671052e7 Pa/s rate; this is float serialization/integration-input precision, not a failed implementation comparison.

quantified.default_OFF: Each new configuration exactly matches all six retained accepted P2 feedback component text results, without rerunning or rewriting the old controls.

quadratic: Actual helper agrees with its discrete reference, not necessarily the continuum. Quadratic zero-flux native rates remain nonzero (up to about91.83 Pa/s on the finite nonperiodic patches). The preexisting lack of exact quadratic balance/conservative pair-flux structure is not hidden or cured by this implementation test.
periodic: Only manually constructed nonempty images in static mult-cell tables were tested here. Full RunPeriodic generation/sorting/resize/stage-lifecycle and coupled dynamic behavior are separate tests. Periodic fields copy owner pressure and are not a periodic-compatible affine physical solution.
limits: No pressure/time/displacement integration, physical force-tail trajectory, mass/energy stability, physical walls, public XML, GPU, formal case, server run, full-cycle or physical acceptance is claimed. Original 5Pa/.005mm independent integration bounds remain unchanged for the real wave stage. No production files were edited by the component worker.
